methods.rsi: Wilder RSI14 over closed-bar close changes; SMA seed14, flat series=50
methods.atr: Wilder ATR14; true range max(H-L,abs(H-prevC),abs(L-prevC)), first TR=H-L
methods.supertrend: ATR10 Wilder, multiplier3, hl2 basic bands, recursive final bands, initial DOWN at first ATR; close-based reversal
methods.momentum: M1 close vs 15 closed minutes earlier
methods.levels: Previous15 M1 bars excluding last signal bar; pivots strict left2/non-strict right2, only after both right bars close
methods.m5: Aggregate aligned groups of five closed M1 bars; incomplete groups excluded
methods.h1_atr: NOT_AVAILABLE: insufficient closed H1 history for ATR14

limitations: All37 scored discovery forecasts from fixed 08:23 snapshot, nineteen scored hour clusters; not independent holdout. Three missed decision windows have no feature snapshot.
Indicators were not used by frozen entry model. No strategy performance or optimal filter inferred.
M5 recursive warmup limited to24 bars; M1 to121, may differ from long TradingView chart history.
M1 and M5 ATR have different horizons; hour range/M5 ATR is descriptive, not daily ATR exhaustion.
Historical levels and confirmed pivots do not imply reversal probability.
Outcome known for selecting this diagnostic; feature values use only contemporaneously available closed candles.
